draft.emotion: ready and helpful, reaching out to let someone in
notes: Used both transitively (ανοίγω την πόρτα, 'I open the door') and intransitively (το μαγαζί ανοίγει στις οκτώ, 'the shop opens at eight').
Contrasts with κλείνω (to close, to turn off). The aorist is άνοιξα.
